content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm facing an issue with EST. I have a project involving an EIB/KNX module. Could someone please help me by programming this project in EST?
What steps have you already attempted?

Hi [user_name], keep in mind that this project requires two separate programs: one for the [product_name] and a second for ETS. Begin by programming the [product_name], test your work, and once it's ready, proceed to configure the KNX project in ETS. Remember to include the [product_name] in your project to connect its inputs and outputs to the group addresses. Give it a try and let us know your results.

Other participants clarify that the process needs two different tools: first programming the [product_name], then configuring KNX in ETS, stressing the importance of workflow and tool distinction.
